q: I wake up at seven o'clock. I brush my teeth and wash my face. Then I have breakfast with my family. I go to school at eight o'clock.
question: What time does the child go to school?
hint: В тексте прямо сказано: «I go to school at eight o'clock» — значит, ребёнок идёт в школу в восемь часов.

q: We visit a farm today. I see a big cow and two small pigs. The sheep is white and fluffy. I like the farm very much.
question: True or False: The child sees three pigs on the farm.
hint: В тексте говорится: «I see a big cow and two small pigs» — ребёнок видит двух свинок, а не трёх, поэтому утверждение неверно.

q: Today is sunny and warm. I wear a red T-shirt and blue shorts. My sister wears a yellow dress. We play in the park.
question: What does the child wear today?
a: A red T-shirt and blue shorts
options: A red T-shirt and blue shorts
hint: В тексте чётко указано: «I wear a red T-shirt and blue shorts» — именно это носит ребёнок в солнечный день.

q: My mum is a teacher. My dad is a doctor. I have a little sister. Her name is Anna. We love our family.
question: True or False: The child's father is a teacher.
hint: В тексте сказано: «My dad is a doctor» — папа работает врачом, а не учителем, поэтому утверждение неверно.

q: I like to draw pictures. My friend Tom likes to play football. We play together after school. It is fun!
question: What does Tom like to do?
hint: В тексте прямо указано: «My friend Tom likes to play football» — Том любит играть в футбол.

q: Look at my cat! Her name is Kitty. She is white and small. She likes milk and fish. She sleeps on my bed.
question: True or False: Kitty likes water and bread.
hint: В тексте сказано: «She likes milk and fish» — Китти любит молоко и рыбу, а не воду и хлеб.

q: I go to school from Monday to Friday. I have English, Maths and Art lessons. My favourite subject is English. I like my school.
question: What is the child's favourite subject?
hint: В тексте чётко написано: «My favourite subject is English» — любимый предмет ребёнка — английский язык.

q: For breakfast I eat an apple and drink milk. For lunch I have soup and bread. For dinner I eat fish and rice. I like healthy food.
question: True or False: The child eats cake for breakfast.
hint: В тексте сказано: «For breakfast I eat an apple and drink milk» — на завтрак ребёнок ест яблоко и пьёт молоко, а не торт.

q: My house is small and nice. It has a kitchen, a living room and two bedrooms. I have my own room. I like my house.
question: How many bedrooms are in the house?
hint: В тексте прямо указано: «It has a kitchen, a living room and two bedrooms» — в доме две спальни.

q: My best friend is Lena. She is eight years old. She has brown hair and blue eyes. We play and study together. I like Lena very much.
question: True or False: Lena has black hair.
hint: В тексте сказано: «She has brown hair and blue eyes» — у Лены каштановые волосы, а не чёрные.

q: In winter it is cold and snowy. I wear a warm coat, a hat and gloves. I like to make a snowman. Winter is fun!
question: What does the child wear in winter?
a: A warm coat, a hat and gloves
options: A warm coat, a hat and gloves
hint: В тексте чётко указано: «I wear a warm coat, a hat and gloves» — именно такую одежду носит ребёнок зимой.

q: I play tennis on Saturdays. My brother plays basketball. On Sundays we ride bikes in the park. We like sports.
question: True or False: The child plays basketball on Saturdays.
hint: В тексте сказано: «I play tennis on Saturdays» — ребёнок играет в теннис по субботам, а не в баскетбол.

q: Today is my birthday! I am nine years old. My friends come to my party. We eat cake and play games. I am happy!
question: How old is the child today?
hint: В тексте прямо написано: «I am nine years old» — сегодня ребёнку исполняется девять лет.

q: We go to the zoo. I see a big elephant and a tall giraffe. The monkeys are funny. I like the zoo very much.
question: True or False: The child sees a lion at the zoo.
hint: В тексте перечислены: слон, жираф и обезьяны. Про льва ничего не сказано, поэтому утверждение неверно.

q: I go shopping with my mum. We buy bread, milk and apples. I carry a small bag. Mum carries a big bag. We go home.
question: What do they buy at the shop?
hint: В тексте чётко указано: «We buy bread, milk and apples» — именно эти продукты они покупают в магазине.

q: I have a pet dog. His name is Rex. He is brown and big. He likes to run and play ball. Rex is my best friend.
question: True or False: Rex is a small black cat.
hint: В тексте сказано: «I have a pet dog. His name is Rex. He is brown and big» — Рекс это большая коричневая собака, а не маленькая чёрная кошка.

q: On Sunday I don't go to school. I sleep late. Then I play with my toys. In the afternoon we visit my grandma. I like weekends.
question: What does the child do on Sunday morning?
hint: В тексте прямо сказано: «On Sunday I don't go to school. I sleep late» — утром в воскресенье ребёнок спит допоздна.

q: We walk in the park. The trees are green. The birds sing. I see ducks on the lake. It is a nice day.
question: True or False: The child sees cats on the lake.
hint: В тексте сказано: «I see ducks on the lake» — на озере ребёнок видит уток, а не кошек.

q: I brush my teeth twice a day. I wash my hands before eating. I eat fruit and vegetables. I want to be healthy.
question: How often does the child brush teeth?
hint: В тексте чётко указано: «I brush my teeth twice a day» — ребёнок чистит зубы два раза в день.

q: We go to the seaside by car. The sun is hot. I swim in the sea. I build a sandcastle. I like summer holidays.
question: True or False: The family goes to the seaside by bus.
hint: В тексте сказано: «We go to the seaside by car» — семья едет на море на машине, а не на автобусе.
